Common questions

Before you invite us to site.

Can you work from existing plans?

Yes. We can price from approved plans and confirm the practical site conditions before finalising the programme.

Can a renovation happen in phases?

Yes. We can separate urgent work from later improvements and price each phase clearly.

Do I need to move out?

Not always. It depends on dust, water and electrical interruptions, access and the rooms involved. We explain the impact before work begins.

Is the online estimate final?

No. It gives a planning range. The final quotation follows measurements, site conditions and confirmed material choices.

Not sure where to start?

Describe the outcome you want.

We’ll help turn the idea into a practical scope.
